subject: Língua Portuguesa

components.description_pt: Destacar partes essenciais de texto considerando objetivos de leitura específicos
components.description_en: Highlight essential parts of a text in light of specific reading objectives
components.cc_component_description: Highlight logical relationships between social studies concepts or elements

components.description_pt: Produzir anotações marginais ou notas de leitura que registrem ideias-chave de um texto
components.description_en: Produce marginal annotations or reading notes that record key ideas from a text
components.cc_component_description: Select and record key details from provided sources with adult guidance

components.description_pt: Compor resumos organizados em formatos como esquemas, quadros sinópticos, abstratos ou mapas conceituais
components.description_en: Compose organized summaries in formats such as outlines, synoptic charts, abstracts, or concept maps
components.cc_component_description: Paraphrase a complex process or concept from a text in accurate, simpler terms

components.description_pt: Selecionar formato de resumo mais apropriado para sistematizar conteúdo e propósitos de texto dado
components.description_en: Select the summary format most appropriate for systematizing the content and purposes of a given text
components.cc_component_description: Write for a range of audiences adjusting tone, content, and format appropriately

cc_matches.description: With guidance and support from adults, recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.
Determine the central ideas or conclusions of a text; summarize complex concepts, processes, or information presented in a text by paraphrasing them in simpler but still accurate terms.

Write routinely over extended time frames (time for research, reflection, and revision) and shorter time frames (a single sitting or a day or two) for a range of discipline-specific tasks, purposes, and audiences.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar explicaciones para...
* introducir y contextualizar fenómenos o eventos
* establecer puntos de vista para comunicar resultados o consecuencias
* relacionar causas y consecuencias con situaciones o eventos
* destacar relaciones lógicas entre elementos o conceptos
* ilustrar ejemplos de eventos históricos que representan cambio y continuidad
* conectar las formas en que transacciones y negocios crean interdependencias entre comunidades
